data.revised_prompt:
Edit the provided scientific journal figure in place, preserving the overall polished vector-like style, layout, left input stack, center five factor rows, active-stereo wall sketch, thumbnails, and black/dark-gray forward arrows. Only update the right-side sensor-output logic and labels to match revised semantics.

Required changes on the right side:
- Remove any boxes or labels for soft validity M, straight-through mask M_ST, valid_prob, teacher fill, loss, backward/gradient paths, and any red arrows.
- Keep the top internal quality response box labeled only:
  "quality Q"
  (this remains an internal response produced by the five S_phi factor rows).
- Replace the two middle boxes that currently show soft validity M and straight-through mask M_ST with one compact internal gate box labeled:
  "quality gate V"
  "V = 1[Q > q0]"
- Draw an arrow from Q to quality gate V.
- Draw V feeding both output compositions.
- Draw D_raw feeding observed depth D_obs.
- Draw Q feeding observed quality Q_obs.
- Show only two far-right output boxes:
  1) "observed depth D_obs" with formula "D_obs = D_raw x V"
  2) "observed quality Q_obs" with formula "Q_obs = Q x V"
- Add a small label near the far-right outputs: "S_phi outputs: (D_obs, Q_obs)"

Left and center must remain visually consistent with the original, including the input stack items and the five factor rows:
- native renderer / raw depth D_raw
- scene/material mask Omega
- speed ||v_t||
- camera registers c = [P, E, G]
- row dependencies: active return (P, D_raw), ambient washout (E, Omega), motion blur (E, ||v_t||), gain/noise (G), edge difficulty (D_raw)
- all five rows merge into quality Q.

Strict text removals:
- remove all occurrences of "soft validity M"
- remove all occurrences of "M_ST"
- remove "straight-through mask"
- do not write valid_prob
- do not write M as a standalone variable

Style constraints:
- clean, high-quality, vector-like SCI journal diagram
- readable labels
- clear black/dark-gray forward arrows only
- no major redesign of left or center content
- no red arrows
- no dense formulas beyond the specified simple ones
